messages.subject: No UI defined
parts:
Hi, 

One of my Shiny apps doesn't works now; I obtain this error message : 


No UI defined

Shiny couldn't find any UI for this application. We looked in:

  • www/index.html
  • ui.R
These apps are installed on Shiny Server on Ubuntu 12.04. Shiny Server v1.0.0.42 (Node.js v0.10.21)

Thanks,

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: No UI defined
parts:
Elodie,

What has changed in your environment that you are now seeing this error?
Did you install a different version of Shiny Server?
Did you install a different version of Shiny?
Did anything change in the directory structure of your application?

Would you mind posting the directory listing of the application you are trying to access? (you can send it in a private email if you prefer)
Also please send the Shiny Server configuration file you are using.


Fereshteh

messages.subject: Re: No UI defined
parts:
- Are you running Shiny Server? What version? (shiny-server --version)
- What Linux distribution and version are you using?
- What is the version of Shiny package?
- What are the contents of your /etc/shiny-server/shiny-server.conf file?
- What are the contents of your application folder?
- Are you able to run the same application locally, using Shiny package in stead of Shiny Server?

Fereshteh
